title: LTX-2.5
description: Text to video with LTX-2.5 (Lightricks), with sound: cinematic motion and camera moves, fast.
pick_when: A fast shot from words alone with a strong camera move and sound, when no person or place must match another shot: it takes no references.

labels.405:376:value: Describe the shot: who, where, the action, the camera and the sound.
labels.405:383:value: Prompt enhance (expands a short prompt first)

hints: Describe the camera move in words: "slow push in", "handheld", "orbit".
Prompt enhance helps a short prompt; a detailed prompt does not need it.
